data.title: EQT to Buy Majority Stake in Specialty European Pharmaceutical Group Kelso Pharma
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Swedish buyout group EQT said it agreed to acquire a majority stake in specialty pharmaceutical group Kelso Pharma from healthcare-investment firm Apposite Capital.

Founded in 2021, Kelso Pharma is a European group with a portfolio of around 14 medicines, mainly for endocrine, gastrointestinal and central nervous system conditions. They are sold through its own U.K.-based commercial infrastructure and exported to more than 30 countries globally.

Kelso Pharma is working to expand the product range to provide additional medicines. EQT said it would support the pharmaceutical company's expansion across Europe through investment in its commercial capabilities, new product launches and selective acquisitions and licensing agreements.

Kelso's management team, led by Chief Executive Officer Tom Stratford, will continue to lead the company.

"Healthcare systems across Europe are increasingly looking to specialist companies to serve patient groups that larger pharmaceutical businesses often overlook," said Mark Braganza, partner at EQT Healthcare Growth.

"With an experienced team, its own commercial infrastructure and a portfolio serving niche patient populations, Kelso has built a strong U.K.-based business with the foundations to grow as a pan-European platform."

The deal is expected to close during the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary conditions and approvals.

data.title: The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments Close on Sale of Controlling Interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa to Coca-Cola HBC AG
data.description:
The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments Close on Sale of Controlling Interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa to Coca-Cola HBC AG

The Coca-Cola Company and Gutsche Family Investments (GFI) have completed the sale of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa Pty. Ltd. (CCBA) to Coca-Cola HBC AG.

The proposed transaction was first announced in October 2025. The companies closed on Nov. 27 after receiving all necessary regulatory approvals in Africa.

Coca-Cola and Coca-Cola HBC have a separate option agreement providing Coca-Cola HBC the opportunity to acquire the remaining 25% stake in CCBA held by Coca-Cola within a six-year period.

CCBA is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in Africa, operating in 14 countries. Following completion of the deal, Coca-Cola HBC is the second-largest Coca-Cola bottler globally by volume, extending its footprint to 43 markets and serving approximately 1.2 billion consumers across Europe and Africa.

Advancing Coca-Cola's Refranchising Strategy

The completion of the transaction marks another significant milestone in Coca-Cola's ongoing strategy to refranchise company-owned and controlled bottling operations.

“This transaction reflects the strength of the Coca-Cola system and our long-term commitment to building locally led, world-class bottling operations,” said Henrique Braun, CEO of The Coca-Cola Company. “CCBA has established a strong foundation across Africa, and Coca-Cola HBC brings proven capabilities, deep market expertise and a successful track record of investing for sustainable growth.”

Luis Felipe Avellar, president of the Africa operating unit of The Coca Cola Company, said, “We are confident this combination will create new opportunities for customers, consumers and communities across the continent. Coca-Cola HBC is a strong, valued partner that has the ability to grow our business in Africa.”

The Gutsche family will remain connected to the Coca-Cola system and Africa through its ownership stake in Coca-Cola HBC.

Strengthening Coca-Cola HBC’s Presence in Africa

The acquisition builds on Coca-Cola HBC’s origins in Nigeria 75 years ago and its expansion into Egypt in 2022. Following completion of the acquisition, Coca-Cola HBC now represents approximately two-thirds of Africa’s total Coca-Cola system volume and serves more than half of the continent’s population. The combination creates a stronger platform to share capabilities, invest in people and infrastructure, and drive sustainable, profitable growth.

Zoran Bogdanovic, CEO of Coca-Cola HBC, said: “Today we mark a historic milestone as we complete the acquisition of CCBA. Africa is where Coca-Cola HBC began 75 years ago, and this acquisition significantly strengthens our presence across this incredible continent, creating a strong platform for sustainable, profitable growth. Our listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange this week further underlines our long-term commitment to South Africa and the broader African continent.

“CCBA is a high-quality business with strong market positions, deep local knowledge and talented people. We are very pleased to welcome our new colleagues to Coca-Cola HBC. Together, we will invest in our leading 24/7 portfolio, our bespoke capabilities and our passionate people to capture the significant opportunities ahead.

“I would like to thank The Coca-Cola Company and the Gutsche family for their trust and partnership, and our teams across CCBA, Coca-Cola HBC and the wider Coca-Cola system for their commitment in completing this transaction. We look forward to working together to drive joint success.”

As part of the transaction, Coca-Cola sold 41.52% of its 66.52% stake in CCBA to Coca-Cola HBC, while Coca-Cola HBC acquired the 33.48% stake held by GFI.

Rothschild & Co. acted as sole financial adviser to Coca-Cola. Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE, Amsterdam Branch and UBS AG London Branch acted as financial advisers to Coca-Cola HBC. Nomura International acted as sole financial adviser to GFI.

About The Coca-Cola Company

The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) is a total beverage company with products sold in more than 200 countries and territories. Our company’s purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We sell multiple billion-dollar brands across several beverage categories worldwide. Our portfolio of sparkling soft drink brands includes Coca-Cola, Sprite and Fanta. Our water, sports, coffee and tea brands include Dasani, smartwater, vitaminwater, Topo Chico, BODYARMOR, Powerade, Costa, Georgia, Fuze Tea, Gold Peak and Ayataka. Our juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverage brands include Minute Maid, Simply, innocent, Del Valle, fairlife and Santa Clara. We’re constantly transforming our portfolio, from reducing sugar in our drinks to bringing innovative new products to market. We seek to positively impact people’s lives, communities and the planet through water replenishment, packaging recycling, sustainable sourcing practices and carbon emissions reductions across our value chain. Together with our bottling partners, we employ more than 700,000 people, helping bring economic opportunity to local communities worldwide. Learn more at www.coca-colacompany.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

About Coca-Cola HBC AG

Coca-Cola HBC is a growth-focused consumer packaged goods business and strategic bottling partner of The Coca-Cola Company. Our business was founded in Nigeria in 1951, and this year we celebrate our 75th anniversary. We open up moments that refresh us all, by creating value for our stakeholders and supporting the socio-economic development of the communities in which we operate. With a vision to be the leading 24/7 beverage partner, we offer drinks for all occasions around the clock. Following the completion of our acquisition of a majority stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa on 27 November 2026, we work together with our customers to serve more than 1.2 billion consumers across 43 markets in Europe and Africa.

Our portfolio is one of the strongest, broadest and most flexible in the beverage industry, with consumer-leading brands across the sparkling, adult sparkling, juice, water, sport, energy, ready-to-drink tea, coffee, and premium spirits categories, with snacks as an additional offering. Our products include Coca-Cola, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Fanta, Sprite, Schweppes, Kinley, Costa Coffee, Caffè Vergnano, Valser, Romerquelle, Dasani and other water brands, FuzeTea, Powerade, Cappy, Monster Energy, Finlandia Vodka, The Macallan, Jack Daniel's and Plazma. We foster an open and inclusive work environment for approximately 50,000 employees and believe that a positive environmental impact is integral to our future growth. We are among the leaders of the global beverage industry across major sustainability benchmarks, including the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices, CDP, MSCI ESG, FTSE ESG and ISS ESG.

Coca-Cola HBC is listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: CCH), Euronext Athens (Euronext Athens: EEE) and the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE: CHB). For more information, please visit https://www.coca-colahellenic.com

data.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise in Shortened Post-Thanksgiving Trade
data.description:
By Emese Bartha

U.S. Treasury yields climbed in Asian trading on Friday as markets reopened for a shortened session following the Thanksgiving holiday.

The two-year Treasury yield rose 4.6 basis points to 4.680%, while the 10-year yield rose 6.6 basis points to 4.913%, according to Tradeweb.

Treasurys face fewer immediate catalysts over the next few days after this week's economic data pointed to persistent inflation, resilient growth, and a solid labor market. Focus now shifts to the Federal Reserve's Dec. 9 interest-rate decision, where a 25-basis-point hike is fully priced, according to LSEG.

"Fed blackout period starts tomorrow so we are not going to get much information from them before the Federal Open Market Committee meeting," Jefferies economist Mohit Kumar said. "Our view remains that the Dec. 8-9 FOMC meeting should mark the peak in [the] Fed's hawkishness."

Jefferies doubts the Fed will match current market pricing, which anticipates 71 basis points of rate hikes by mid-2027, LSEG data shows.

While the 10-year Treasury yield might have reached its cycle peak, it is premature to expect a sustained drop, SEB strategists Jussi Hiljanen and Filip Carlsson said.

"The bond rally since mid-November has been fueled by the equity sell-off, perceived risks of overtightening and lower inflation expectations," they said. The strategists noted that stabilizing risk appetite could push yields back up, while continued caution would support bonds.

Meanwhile, Societe Generale rates strategists said that a restrictive Fed path is largely priced in, capping upside for five-year yields unless policymakers turn more hawkish.

"As growth and inflation gradually moderate, the intermediate sector should remain anchored by the expected policy path," they said.

data.title: XPENG Accelerates Global Physical AI Expansion at the 2026 Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition
data.description:
• In a world-first, XPENG’s humanoid robot IRON hosted an automotive press conference, announcing the establishment of XPENG’s Hong Kong R&D Centre, dedicated to humanoid robotics and general-purpose intelligence. IRON is set to begin its international deployment in the second half of 2027.
  • XPENG is on track to surpass 100,000 annual overseas vehicle sales for the first time in 2026 and aims to more than double its overseas sales in 2027.
  • XPENG plans to introduce five new models across overseas markets in 2027, including the New P7, which will launch in Europe, its first overseas market, in the second quarter of 2027. The next wave of expansion begins with the L05’s launch in Thailand in December 2026.
  • XPENG plans to deploy four X-Energy megawatt charging stations across three continents within three months, accelerating the global expansion of its charging infrastructure.
  • XPENG plans to begin the overseas rollout of its advanced driver-assistance system in the first half of 2027, with a global launch of its Robotaxi targeted for 2027.

GUANGZHOU, China, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- XPENG today unveiled the next phase of its global Physical AI strategy at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, outlining its 2027 expansion roadmap across AI vehicles, humanoid robotics and autonomous mobility. Key plans include the introduction of five new vehicle models across international markets, with Europe confirmed as the first overseas market for the New P7, alongside the planned overseas deployment of its humanoid robot IRON and the international introduction of its Robotaxi programme.

XPENG also announced the establishment of its Hong Kong R&D Centre, the company’s ninth R&D centre worldwide, alongside plans to expand its X-Energy megawatt charging infrastructure across three continents.

Building on XPENG AI Day 2026 earlier in the week, the exhibition brought together international media and partners to experience how XPENG is translating its Physical AI innovations into real-world applications.


XPENG showcases its latest innovations in Physical AI at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show.

IRON Takes the Mic: From Stage to Showroom

At the Guangzhou Auto Show, IRON took centre stage to host XPENG’s press conference, introducing its capabilities and interacting with an international audience. Beyond the stage, multiple IRON humanoid robots took on customer-facing roles together for the first time, serving as sales assistants, receptionists and technology guides across XPENG’s exhibition booth. They welcomed visitors, introduced vehicles and answered product enquiries, demonstrating their potential for real-world retail applications.

During the press conference, IRON also announced the official establishment of XPENG’s Hong Kong R&D Centre, which will focus on humanoid robotics and general-purpose intelligence. Its key research areas include whole-body motion control, mobile manipulation, world models and embodied intelligence. Research will also span advanced algorithms, AI software and system architecture, and data engineering. Leveraging Hong Kong’s strong research ecosystem and technology talent, the new centre will further strengthen XPENG’s global R&D capabilities in Physical AI.


XPENG’s humanoid robots IRON demonstrate their service capabilities, welcoming visitors and introducing vehicles at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show.

After eight years of research and development, IRON is moving beyond technology demonstrations towards real-world service applications. In the first quarter of 2027, IRON will begin its first showroom assignments at XPENG retail locations in China, gaining practical experience in everyday retail environments. In the second half of 2027, XPENG plans to extend IRON’s deployment internationally, starting with its overseas showroom network.

“The true value of Physical AI lies not in what technology can demonstrate on stage, but in what it can deliver in the real world,” said He Xiaopeng, Chairman and CEO of XPENG. “IRON’s transition from research and development to everyday service environments represents an important step in this journey. We believe the next wave of AI innovation will increasingly take place in the physical world, transforming how people move, work and interact with technology. In 2027, we plan to accelerate the global deployment of our AI vehicles, humanoid robots and Robotaxis, turning technological innovation into tangible value for customers around the world.”


He Xiaopeng, Chairman and CEO of XPENG, joins humanoid robot IRON on stage at XPENG’s press conference at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show.

XPENG Accelerates Global Vehicle Expansion with Five New Models in 2027

XPENG’s international business is entering a new phase of growth, with annual overseas vehicle sales on track to surpass 100,000 units for the first time in 2026. In October alone, overseas deliveries reached a record 13,326 vehicles, representing a year-on-year increase of 166%.

XPENG’s global sales and service network now spans 83 countries and regions, with more than 1,300 retail stores worldwide. In Europe, cumulative deliveries have surpassed 10,000 vehicles in each of Denmark, Norway, France and Germany. XPENG also ranks as the best-selling Chinese automotive brand in Europe for battery-electric vehicles priced above €40,000 from January to October 2026, underscoring its strong position in the region’s premium EV market segment.

This momentum is underpinned by growing customer recognition and strong market performance across regions. XPENG ranked first for brand recommendation in the USCALE EV Satisfaction Study across Germany, Austria and Switzerland for two consecutive years, in 2025 and 2026, while the XPENG X9 became the first MPV to win the Luxury category of the German Car of the Year 2027 awards. The X9 also achieved segment-leading sales in several Asia-Pacific markets, while the XPENG GX secured more than 5,000 orders within a month of its introduction across multiple Middle Eastern and African markets.

XPENG’s next wave of international product expansion will begin in December 2026 with the launch of the XPENG L05, a spacious, intelligent five-seat SUV designed for families, in Thailand, its first overseas market. The model will then officially launch in Europe at the Brussels Motor Show in January 2027.

In 2027, XPENG plans to introduce five new vehicle models across key international markets, broadening its product portfolio to address a wider range of customer needs. Among them is the New P7, which will make its international market debut in Europe in the second quarter of 2027. Since its appearance at IAA Mobility 2025 in Munich, the model has attracted interest from European audiences, with its distinctive design earning the prestigious 2026 Red Dot Design Award.

“We aim to more than double our overseas vehicle sales in 2027 compared with 2026,” said Alex, Vice President of XPENG International Business. “But our focus goes beyond sales growth and new vehicle launches. It is about understanding local customer needs, strengthening our local presence and building lasting relationships with customers and partners. These are the foundations for our long-term growth in international markets.”


Alex, Vice President of XPENG International Business, shares XPENG’s global business updates and 2027 international expansion plans at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show.

Accelerating the Global Rollout of X-Energy Megawatt Charging

Alongside its global vehicle expansion, XPENG is accelerating the deployment of its X-Energy megawatt charging infrastructure, with plans to expand its network across three continents by the end of 2026. Following the opening of its first X-Energy megawatt charging station in Hong Kong in September 2026, XPENG plans to deploy its second station in Hong Kong, Australia’s first megawatt charging station, and its first two X-Energy stations in Europe, located in Germany and the Netherlands, respectively.

Built on XPENG’s in-house-developed energy storage and ultra-fast charging technology, the X-Energy system can deliver up to 1,000 kW of peak power with a grid connection of no more than 240 kW. By using stored energy to boost charging output, the system reduces pressure on local power grids and facilitates the deployment of megawatt charging infrastructure in densely populated urban areas with limited grid capacity and space, while supporting the second-life use of retired EV batteries.

From Advanced Driver Assistance to Autonomous Mobility

Beyond expanding its vehicle portfolio, XPENG is accelerating the international introduction of its advanced driver-assistance technology. Building on large-scale public test rides at the Paris Motor Show, XPENG became the first Chinese automaker to offer public test rides of advanced urban driver-assistance technology at an overseas retail location, bringing its intelligent driving technology closer to everyday consumers.

Powered by the VLA 2.0 architecture, XPENG’s advanced driver-assistance system, NGP, is undergoing international testing and localisation ahead of a planned overseas rollout in the first half of 2027, subject to local validation, regulatory requirements and market readiness.

XPENG is also extending its Physical AI capabilities into autonomous mobility through YoYo-01, its purpose-built Robotaxi, which is undergoing Level 4 autonomous driving tests. Built on XPENG’s fully in-house-developed technology stack, including its Turing AI chips, VLA 2.0 model and autonomous driving software, YoYo-01 leverages a shared AI technology foundation spanning Level 2 driver assistance and Level 4 autonomous driving.

With a global launch targeted for 2027, XPENG aims to explore international opportunities in Robotaxi services, expanding the application of its AI technologies beyond private vehicles.

As XPENG enters its next phase of global growth, its international strategy is evolving beyond intelligent vehicles to encompass a broader ecosystem of Physical AI technologies. Through AI vehicles, humanoid robots and Robotaxis, XPENG aims to bring the benefits of AI into everyday life for people around the world.

Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UAVsPV9fBEUxAi02iVr1Cc5FDwdbeA39 

About XPENG

XPENG is a leading global Physical AI company, dedicated to bringing artificial intelligence into the physical world to reshape future mobility and smart living. Through in-house R&D, XPENG has developed a full-stack Physical AI architecture spanning Turing AI chips, world foundation models, and highly integrated software and hardware applications. This unified technology foundation of XPENG powers an expansive product portfolio of smart EVs, robotaxis, and humanoid robots, advancing the deployment of Physical AI at scale.

Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, XPENG is dual-primary listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. With global capabilities across R&D, manufacturing, sales, and services, XPENG drives continuous technological innovation and fosters an open Physical AI ecosystem, making life smarter, safer, and better for users worldwide. data.title: SAP Says No Decisions Made on Job Cuts as AI Reshapes Landscape
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

SAP said it is continuously reviewing how its organization and workforce need to evolve as artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes the business environment, but that no decisions have been made on restructuring or job cuts.

A spokesperson for the German business-software group made the comments after Bloomberg reported, citing unnamed sources, that the company was exploring at least 10,000 job cuts in response to the accelerating AI shift.

Bloomberg reported that discussions were continuing, and that the restructuring could affect at least 9% of the group's global workforce, although the total number of jobs hadn't yet been finalized.

The SAP spokesperson said job roles and functions would naturally change over time, but beyond that, no decisions had been made regarding any further measures.

"We do not comment on speculation," the spokesperson said.

data.title: Chinese Shares Lifted as Beijing Signals More Market Support
data.description:
By Sherry Qin

Chinese stocks were lifted as authorities reiterated support for capital markets and vowed stabilization policies, amid increased volatility in global markets.

According to state media Xinhua News Agency, Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Friday chaired a State Council executive meeting focused on market reforms.

The meeting noted that "the capital market is crucial to the overall economic development," and China would improve its market stabilization mechanism and introduce new policies to promote stable and healthy markets, Xinhua reported.

As part of this, the role of China's state investors--the so-called "national team"--in stabilizing the markets and countering volatility would be strengthened. Also, efforts would be made to optimize the function of Central Huijin, a unit of state-owned sovereign wealth fund China Investment, as a quasi-stabilization fund.

It also said that Beijing will guide medium- and long-term funds into the markets and listed companies should be encouraged to pay more dividends and step up share repurchases.

Although the measures look to be mostly reiterating previously announced ones, the language has shifted incrementally to show a bit more urgency and tangible action, according to ING chief China economist Lynn Song.

Chinese stock markets have weakened in recent months, broadly in line with global market as investors cool on tech-related companies. The U.S.'s recent efforts to tighten AI chips exports and renewed tariffs have also weighed on investor sentiment.

The benchmark Shanghai Composite Index has fallen over 15% from its peak in May but picked up on Friday, likely supported by the signals of support from Beijing.

The Shanghai Composite Index was recently up 3.6%, the Shenzhen Composite Index was 6.8% higher and the tech-heavy ChiNext Price Index surged 10.6%, on track for its biggest one-day percentage gain in over two years.

data.title: Bitcoin, Ether Rebound as Markets Stabilize
data.description:
By Joseph Wilkins

Bitcoin rebounded above $61,000 on Friday as Asian markets stabilized and risk appetite returned to cryptocurrencies.

Bitcoin was 1.5% higher at $61,658, while ether gained 1.9% to $1,735. U.S. futures were higher on Friday following a break for Thanksgiving, with Asian markets taking cues. South Korea's Kospi rose over 4%, with chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics jumping 6.3% and 4.2%, respectively.

Bitcoin's 90-day correlation to the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq-100 has rebuilt since reaching a year-to-date low in September, Block Scholes analyst Thahbib Rahman wrote in a note. Bitcoin's current correlation is 53% to the S&P 500 and 54% to the Nasdaq-100, up from 37% and 36% at the end of October.

Rahman said the flagship cryptocurrency could remain stuck as long as fears around the durability of the AI trade persist and drag down U.S. stocks.
